Resize PDF to A4

Resize a PDF so every page fits A4: orientation is detected automatically and pages are scaled proportionally, all in your browser.

Resize PDF to A4

Scale every page to fit A4 — orientation auto-detected per page, aspect ratio preserved.

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload a PDF of any page size.
  2. Optionally add padding around each page.
  3. Click "Resize to A4 & Download".
  4. Every page is scaled to fit A4 with correct orientation.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Will pages be stretched?

Each page is scaled proportionally to fit inside A4 (portrait or landscape chosen per page), so nothing is stretched or squashed.

How is orientation chosen?

Pages wider than tall become A4 landscape; taller pages become A4 portrait — decided per page, automatically.

Are my files uploaded anywhere?

Everything is processed locally in your browser with PDF-Lib. Your files are never uploaded to any server.
